properties.name: spawn_daemon stops resolving a deleted inode. FOURTH INSTANCE, 2026-08-11: a mid-session `cargo build -p reflow2-mcp` relinked target/debug/reflow2-mcp under the attached daemon, so current_exe() returned a path ending ' (deleted)' and Command::new on that literal path returned ENOENT — blocking every graph tool for ~40 minutes. Implements the fix_shape fact:defect-rebuild-strands-the-shared-server recorded on 2026-08-07 and nobody built: fall back to the resolved binary path when current_exe() no longer exists, and name the path in the error. NOTE issue #91 (finding 2 of 3) is CLOSED with this finding unfixed. Independently reported the same week by an unrelated project's agent-side feedback, whose ask was narrower and also right: the error never names the file it could not find.
